title: Tailwind CSS lays off three of its four engineers after Google traffic to its documentation fell ~40% from early 2023 due to AI, causing an ~80% drop in revenue (Barry Schwartz/Search Engine Roundtable)
summary: Barry Schwartz / Search Engine Roundtable: Tailwind CSS lays off three of its four engineers after Google traffic to its documentation fell ~40% from early 2023 due to AI, causing an ~80% drop in revenue — Adam Wathan the creator of Tailwind CSS posted that he had to let go of 75% of his engineering team because of AI.
